name: death-back
prompt: Production animation sprite sheet of the APPROVED BUGBEAR in the supplied reference. Copy this exact shaggy brown-furred muscular goblinoid, broad face/tusks/ears, worn hide armor and straps, boots, rigid iron-spiked morningstar in ANATOMICAL RIGHT hand and wood round shield in ANATOMICAL LEFT hand. Match detailed shaded textured retro dungeon art, muted earth colors, crisp edges and neutral illumination. Reference is for IDENTITY only, do NOT reproduce its four-direction layout. BACK view facing directly away; right-hand morningstar on image RIGHT and left shield on image LEFT; show back of head/armor, no frontal face. Exactly FOUR DEATH/COLLAPSE poses in an equal 2 by 2 grid in reading order. Top-left begins to buckle while almost standing, top-right knees collapse and torso lowers, bottom-left falls onto side/front at ground level, bottom-right final motionless low corpse with weapon and shield beside or attached to SAME body. Body remains intact with shaggy fur and hide armor. Keep identical anatomical and weapon scale in ALL cells: fallen bodies naturally much shorter vertically and wider, NEVER enlarge low poses to fill cells. No blood, no bones pile, no disappearing equipment. For two-frame sheets use a 1536x1024 landscape canvas, TWO equal 768-wide cells; upright bugbear about 800px tall with generous margins. For four-frame sheets use 1536x1536 square, FOUR equal cells, upright about 580px tall. Prone single-pose sheets use a wide landscape canvas with large transparent margins. Identical scale and LOCAL invisible ground baseline within cells, every head/foot/shield/weapon/spike fully inside own cell with transparent gaps. Maintain right/left equipment anatomy in every pose; no mirroring or extra limbs. Actual transparent alpha background and gaps between limbs, NO background, floor, cast shadow, glow, text, labels, borders, grid lines or scene.
